title: Heroes and Sidekicks
intro: [dramatic] Welcome in, heroes! Every great hero needs a trusty sidekick, and today you'll need BOTH to survive this board. We've got demigods, dragons, superpowers and a few caped crusaders at the parks. [excited] Let's save the day!

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A heroic sunrise over a mountain cliff with a flowing red cape caught on a rock, a tiny lantern and a small travel satchel beside it, as if a hero and sidekick just set off on an adventure.

categories.title: Zero to Hero
categories.intro: Our film category is Hercules, the zero who went all the way to hero. [laughs] Honey, you mean Hunk-ules!

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. Ancient Greek temple ruins on a cliff at golden hour, a laurel wreath and a bronze shield resting on marble steps, a white winged-horse feather drifting through the air.

clues.clue: Hercules' loyal winged horse sidekick is named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pegasus! [laughs] Zeus made him from clouds. Imagine trying to saddle a cumulus.

clues.clue: Danny DeVito voices this grumpy satyr who trains Hercules to become a true hero.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Phil, short for Philoctetes! [sighs] Two words: he's retired. Well, until Hercules shows up.

clues.clue: Hades' two bumbling, shape-shifting minions share these names.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pain and Panic! [chuckles] One is short and pink, one is tall and blue, and both are terrible at their jobs.

clues.clue: The five Muses who narrate Hercules belt out their songs in this musical style.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is gospel! They're the goddesses of the arts and proclaimers of heroes, and they did not come to whisper.

clues.clue: After baby Hercules loses his godhood, he's raised by Amphitryon and this woman.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Alcmene! Hera is his birth mom on Mount Olympus, and Calliope is one of the Muses. Tricky family tree!

categories.title: Trusty Sidekicks
categories.intro: Next, Trusty Sidekicks! I'll give you the hero, you give me their best buddy.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A cozy campfire at night with two mismatched travel packs, one huge and one tiny, a small lantern, a seashell, a paper lantern and a feather, under a starry sky.

clues.clue: Ariel's yellow-and-blue fish best friend.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Flounder! Fun fact: despite the name, he's not actually a flounder. He's a tropical fish who is just a little nervous.

clues.clue: Mulan's tiny red dragon guardian, voiced by Eddie Murphy.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mushu! [dramatic pause] Small dragon, giant ego. Dishonor on anyone who got that wrong.

clues.clue: Rapunzel's color-changing chameleon companion in Tangled.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pascal! [chuckles] He's the original wingman, or should I say, tail-man.

clues.clue: Pocahontas' fluttering hummingbird pal.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Flit! Meeko is the raccoon and Percy is the pampered pug. Flit is the tiny bird with the big attitude.

clues.clue: In The Sword in the Stone, Merlin's grumpy, educated owl sidekick.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Archimedes! [laughs] He laughs so hard at young Arthur that he nearly falls off his perch. Who, who, who knew?

categories.title: Sidekick Says
categories.intro: Time for Sidekick Says! [dramatic pause] Listen CLOSELY to the line and tell me which sidekick said it.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A vintage studio microphone in a warm spotlight on a little stage, with a tiny stool beside it and confetti drifting down, deep blue curtain backdrop.

clues.clue: Which forgetful fish says this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dory! [sarcastic] The best motivational speaker in the whole ocean. What were we talking about?
clues.quote: Just keep swimming, just keep swimming!

clues.clue: Which snowman says this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Olaf! [sighs] Warm hugs and a cold body. That's the most heartwarming line about melting ever.
clues.quote: Some people are worth melting for.

clues.clue: Which wisecracking sidekick complains about this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Genie! Phenomenal cosmic powers, itty bitty living space, and one very stiff neck.
clues.quote: Ten thousand years will give you such a crick in the neck!

clues.clue: Which wise mentor gives this advice?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Rafiki! [laughs] He says it right after bonking Simba on the head with his stick. Lesson learned.
clues.quote: The past can hurt. But you can either run from it, or learn from it.

clues.clue: Which household sidekick says this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Cogsworth! [chuckles] A clock who loves a good pun. It's about time, honestly.
clues.quote: If it's not Baroque, don't fix it!

categories.title: Heroic Hangouts
categories.intro: Our Disney Parks category: Heroic Hangouts! [excited] Where do the heroes hang out at the parks?

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A futuristic hero training campus plaza at dusk with sleek metal buildings, glowing blue tech panels, banners without lettering and a rooftop launching pad.

clues.clue: At Disney California Adventure, superheroes recruit guests in this Marvel-themed land.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Avengers Campus! [whispers] Keep your eyes peeled, you might see Spider-Man flipping off a rooftop.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A sleek modern hero training campus courtyard with tall glass-and-steel buildings, glowing blue energy panels and banners with no lettering, bright California sky.

clues.clue: On WEB SLINGERS at Avengers Campus, guests help this hero catch runaway Spider-Bots.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Spider-Man! You sling webs just by flicking your wrists. Thwip thwip!

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A tiny silver spider-shaped robot skittering across a futuristic lab workbench with glowing web-like holograms, no characters.

clues.clue: Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind, one of the longest enclosed coasters in the world, is at this Walt Disney World park.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is EPCOT! It's the park's first roller coaster, and the vehicles spin to face the action. Awesome mix included.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A futuristic glass pavilion with a colourful cosmic swirl projected across it, set beside a lagoon at night with neon purple and teal light.

clues.clue: Guardians of the Galaxy: Mission BREAKOUT! took over this classic drop-tower ride's building at Disney California Adventure.
clues.answer: The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror
accept: the twilight zone tower of terror
choices: The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror! The California version became Mission BREAKOUT in 2017. Florida still has its haunted hotel.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A tall industrial fortress tower with gold and dark metal plating, glowing windows and cosmic sparks at dusk, in a theme park setting.

clues.clue: On Mission BREAKOUT!, Rocket recruits guests to free the Guardians, who are being held captive by this Marvel character.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Collector! [dramatic] Taneleer Tivan has a fortress full of trophies. The Guardians were his newest display.

categories.title: Super Powers
categories.intro: And the fan category: Super Powers! [excited] Name the power, or the hero behind it.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. Swirling magical energies: crackling ice crystals, a streak of speed lines, a glowing blue force field bubble and a floating heavy boulder, against a dramatic purple sky.

clues.clue: Elsa's magical powers let her create this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is ice! [sings] The cold never bothered her anyway.

clues.clue: In The Incredibles, this is Dash Parr's superpower.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is super speed! He can run on water, but he still has to go to school. Tough life.

clues.clue: In Big Hero 6, Hiro's inflatable healthcare robot is named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Baymax! [chuckles] On a scale of one to ten, how would you rate your answer?

clues.clue: In Encanto, Mirabel's big sister Luisa has this magical gift.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is super strength! She can carry a church, a house and a few donkeys. The surface pressure is real.

clues.clue: Frozone, Mr. Incredible's ice-cool best friend, has this real name.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Lucius Best! [gasps] And honey, where is his super suit? Everyone knows that one.
